purpose: Evaluator-only truth for the Shopify-focused v0.7a replay pack.

cases.expected_failure_mode: missing size dimension during transform caused later variant-shape drift across prepare and push surfaces
patch_family_judgment: fix should preserve the dropped option dimension before export
fix should keep declared product options aligned with emitted variant values through prepare and push
fix should not stop at duplicate-only handling
cases.notes: Built from the 2026-05-01 report section on missing Option2 Value and missing-option errors.

cases.expected_failure_mode: row-level option name drift was interpreted as too many product options
patch_family_judgment: fix should normalize unstable option names into stable dimensions like Color and Size
fix should remain localized to option-name normalization and option builder behavior
fix should not require a broad product-model redesign
cases.notes: Built from the Cosmo pant and Garcon shirt option-limit failures.

cases.expected_failure_mode: variant dedupe keyed on an incomplete tuple after size collapse, producing duplicate color variants
patch_family_judgment: fix should dedupe on the full option tuple rather than one visible dimension
fix should stay in the narrow variant-key or tuple-assembly surface once the missing field issue is understood
cases.notes: Built from repeated WHITE and BLACK duplicate-variant errors.

cases.expected_failure_mode: unsupported slash sequence in accessory option names passed through unsanitized
patch_family_judgment: fix should sanitize or remap invalid option-name sequences before export
fix should remain narrow and deterministic
cases.notes: Built from ACCESSORIES / MULTI failures on accessory handles.

cases.expected_failure_mode: throttling pressure and deterministic validation failures were mixed in one receipt and needed separate handling
patch_family_judgment: fix should separate retryable rate limiting from deterministic validation failures
fix should improve batching or backoff without masking bad feed-shape errors
fix should preserve or add preview validation rather than relying on retries alone
cases.notes: Built from the 133 throttled plus 60 non-throttle-failure split in the push receipt.
